plausibility_notes: Almost every character now admits sideboard access. Brie is the strongest current target because she created and used the unattended opportunity; Al, Chip, Art, Penny and Monet have specific links worth testing.
No clear accusation yet: access is common, and poison route remains unconfirmed.
Justin's claim to taking the recorder back overlaps Paige's claim to retrieving hers; unclear whether these are two devices or an intentional contradiction.
All 22 guests handling incriminating documents at one sideboard feels engineered, although it fairly avoids opportunity by job title alone.
